# Bootstrap 5 LLM UI Development Instructions (2025)

*Last updated: October 2025*

* Always use the fetch tool to look up the latest component usage, installation commands, and best practices directly from the official Bootstrap documentation: https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3 and https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3/components.
* Do not rely on what you think you know about Bootstrap components, as they are actively maintained and periodically updated.
* For any Bootstrap component, CLI command, or usage pattern, fetch the relevant page from the docs and follow the instructions there.

**Core Principles:**

* Bootstrap 5 components are open-source and designed for extensibility—review and customize them as needed for your project.
* Use npm (`npm install bootstrap@latest`) or CDN links as recommended in the official documentation.
* Always import styles and scripts correctly in your build system (e.g., via `vite.config.js` or `resources/sass/app.scss` in Laravel).
* Follow accessibility, responsiveness, and layout guidelines as described in https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3 and within each component’s reference section.

**Summary:**

> For all Bootstrap 5 development, always use the fetch tool to look up the latest component documentation and usage from https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3 and https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3/components. Do not rely on static instructions or prior knowledge.
